part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Friends
questions: How often do you go out with friends? [Why/Why not?]
Tell me about your best friend at school.
How friendly are you with your neighbours? [Why/Why not?]
Which is more important to you, friends or family? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a writer you would like to meet.
points: what you know about this writer already
what you would like to find out about him/her
part2.closing: and explain why you would like to meet this writer.

topics.title: Reading and children
questions: What kinds of book are most popular with children in your country? Why do you think that is?
Why do you think some children do not read books very often?
How do you think children can be encouraged to read more?

topics.title: Reading for different purposes
questions: Are there any occasions when reading at speed is a useful skill to have? What are they?
Are there any jobs where people need to read a lot? What are they?
Do you think that reading novels is more interesting than reading factual books? Why is that?
